why: T12: the real-content golden corpus validated the TS port against the Python oracle and was dropped with it — the redistributable repo carries no personal editorial data. From here the suite is TS self-regression: expected/ is frozen from the pipeline's own output over this schema-shaped micro-world. The oracle-parity record lives in git history and design/verification/phase-c.md.

normalization.isoTimestamps: every timestamp in the DB dump is rewritten to the epoch before comparing (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP metadata); with todayIso pinned to the fixture Sunday there is no capture-day token — the corpus is fully deterministic
normalization.jsonNumberFormatting: export JSON comparisons stay parsed-value based (formatting-neutral)
